ModMetaData.name: Colonist Pride
ModMetaData.author: Gemdave
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists take pride in the fine work they create — and feel it when that work is lost.
Colonist Pride adds mood effects tied to the quality of items your colonists craft:
- Pride: Colonists will be given a mood boost when they create high quality items - Shame: Colonists will receive a mood negative when they create items of low quality - Heartbreak: Colonists will receive a mood negative when a high quality item that they created gets destroyed - Relief: Colonists will be given a small mood boost when low quality items they created gets destroyed - Other colonists will think more highly of colonists who churn out high quality items - Fully adjustable in the settings
Requires Harmony.
